genese.title: The Alliance of Streaming & Physical Art
genese.intro: To perfect the atmosphere of his studio, Grim was looking for a strong, vivid contemporary art piece capable of grabbing attention on camera.
genese.quoteSub: The live unveiling in front of thousands of fans
genese.body: InRealArt Agency orchestrated the secure shipment of the artwork from François Poulat's studio to Grim's setup. From unboxing the armored wood crate to the final placement under the setup, relive the behind-the-scenes of this creation.

01.title: The Studio's Standard
01.description: A balanced Pop Art composition designed to stand out vividly under Grim's stream lighting.

02.title: Poulat's Gesture
02.description: Layers of material, coats of acrylic and meticulous stenciling applied by hand in the studio.

03.title: Physical Certificate
03.description: Each print comes with an official numbered certificate hand-signed by François Poulat.

artist.title: The Pop Art Material of François Poulat
artist.body: Exhibited internationally, François Poulat stands out for his mastery of color contrasts and his poetic rearrangement of Pop Culture icons. His canvases combine graphic rigor with the raw energy of palette-knife painting.
artist.quote: "Reinventing Pop iconography for Grim's studio was a captivating challenge: blending gaming energy with the nobility of a canvas worked in thick layers."

payment.question: How does the 50% deposit payment work?
payment.answer: When you make your reservation, you only pay 50% of your print's total value through our secure checkout. This first payment immediately secures your spot in the production queue. The remaining 50% balance is only requested once the piece is finished, inspected, and ready to ship.

delivery.question: What are the production and delivery times?
delivery.answer: Since each artwork is carefully prepared and varnished on its frame, expect 2 to 3 weeks of production. Shipping then takes 48 to 72h via a carrier specialized in artwork, with priority tracking.

packaging.question: How is the artwork packaged?
packaging.answer: All our physical art editions are wrapped in moisture-protective film, cushioned in high-density foam, then locked in a reinforced armored wood crate specifically sized for the selected dimensions.

certificate.question: Does the artwork come with a certificate of authenticity?
certificate.answer: Yes, absolutely. Every physical print delivered by InRealArt Agency includes its Physical Certificate of Authenticity, sealed, numbered, and hand-signed by the artist François Poulat.
